Sargent TBDLU93E3MI15, MI Dummy Lever with Square Rose

This is a Through Bolted Single Dummy Lever. The MI lever with E3 2-1/16 inch square rosette is from Sargent's Aventura Series.

Specifications for the Sargent MI lever with E3 Square Rose:

  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Lever Length: 5-13/32"
  • Lever Projection: 2-19/32"
  • Rose Length: 2-1/16" square
